title: Another setback for Mamata Banerjee as MP Koel Mallick resigns from Rajya Sabha
description: TMC Rajya Sabha MP and actor Koel Mallick resigns from the Upper House, becoming the latest leader to quit Mamata Banerjee's party amid a wave of defections. Her exit comes a day after senior MLA Madan Mitra joined the rebel Trinamool faction.
